basics.name: Poojan Shrivastav
basics.label: Full Stack Developer • AI Engineering Student
basics.summary: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence student (Gandhinagar Institute of Technology, 2024–2028) shipping production full-stack and AI products. Currently Developer Intern at KaryaUp (analytics, CDN migration, AI voice calling, ~80% payload optimization), Full Stack Developer at 13 UTOPIA (FormX Consultants & Navkar Tubes), and Co-Founder at Oneverce (Travebie). Runner-Up at Build With AI Ahmedabad for OpenBridge.

bullets: Built first-party Analytics HQ with IP geolocation telemetry and automated bot filtering for a live business SaaS platform.
Cut initial payload ~80% (36 MB → 6.89 MB) by migrating media from MongoDB Atlas to AWS S3 + CloudFront CDN and trimming vendor bundles.
Implemented IP-based geo pricing (INR / USD) and Nginx reverse-proxy streaming with 1KB whitespace flush for real-time AI token delivery.
Shipped AI voice calling agent features and projected lean MongoDB schemas that unblocked admin list hangs.
Delivered FormX Consultants — 40+ route Next.js 16 / React 19 architectural consulting platform with a custom brand design system.
Built Navkar Tubes & Tools — industrial B2B site with interactive pipe weight calculator, MTC inspection UI, and Express serverless inquiry APIs.
Shipped Travebie (travebie.com), an AI travel booking platform with a 19-intent engine and 18 dynamic chat card UI components.
Added Playwright E2E coverage across booking/planner flows and PWA offline caching with a React Native admin companion.
